sources.shortQuote: -ake: its; their, theirs, (inanimate); -ao: their, theirs (animate only)
sources.supports: Withdraw finding 0012: hospitali is inanimate, so maana yake is valid even for plural hospitals. Retain finding 0032: inanimate galaxies take kanuni zake; -ao in zao would identify animate plural possessors. Possessive agreement prefix follows possessed noun; findings 0048 and 0089 are withdrawn.
